findings.description: Direct inspection of current V204 renders and independent Astra review: in sit and crouch both thighs extend beyond the overskirt front while lilac-edged panels fold behind the knees and white panels hang below the seat. The V203 shorts extension remains a separate upper-thigh layer and does not preserve outer-skirt coverage.

Front, three-quarter, neutral and side renders retain dense angular creases across the front overskirt. V204 seam-locked front-panel fairing did not produce clean broad channels and visual improvement is insufficient; preserve seams and hem while reshaping pleat relief.
Prone still tents and bunches the skirt. Side silhouettes retain the trailing hem step/tail, and gray body patches remain at sleeve roots/armholes in front and raised-arm views.

nextAction: Keep V204 rejected. Redesign front-skirt pose response so the overskirt hem and panels follow both thighs during crouch and sit; the added shorts are not a substitute for outer-skirt coverage. Reshape the pleat relief to create broad channels without dense angular creases while preserving seams and the lilac hem. Correct prone drape, side hem continuity, and sleeve-root coverage. Rebuild and directly inspect all five views and six poses; fit, rig/weight, Shape Key, Unity/VRChat, package, and release gates remain unverified.
